title: SOURCE_TARGETS retired: InfoSchema syncer MDL check uses background sys-session pool

analysis: The dynamic hit is refreshMDLCheckTableInfo, where Syncer borrows a session from s.sysSessionPool, rolls it back, and reads mysql.tidb_mdl_info through ExecuteInternal/ExecSQL
Syncer is constructed by Domain with do.sysSessionPool, not with a user statement session
Domain starts Syncer.SyncLoop and Syncer.MDLCheckLoop as background goroutines after DDL/domain startup
SyncLoop calls refreshMDLCheckTableInfo from ticker/schema-version events, not from a user SQL statement wrapper
The cross-keyspace variant follows the same shape: it builds a Syncer with a session pool and starts SyncLoop/MDLCheckLoop in background goroutines

Therefore pending user one-shot state such as TxnReadTS/SnapshotInfoschema cannot be consumed by this path unless a test injects it into the sys-session pool, which would test harness setup rather than a product schedule
source_anchors: pkg/infoschema/issyncer/syncer.go:157-171 refreshMDLCheckTableInfo gets s.sysSessionPool.Get(), rolls back, defers Put, and uses the session for internal SQL
pkg/infoschema/issyncer/syncer.go:296-356 SyncLoop is the background reload loop and calls refreshMDLCheckTableInfo after each tick/schema event
pkg/domain/domain.go:814-820 sets MinJobIDRefresher and starts do.isSyncer.SyncLoop / MDLCheckLoop via domain waitgroup
pkg/domain/crossks/cross_ks.go:281-319 constructs NewCrossKSSyncer with sessPool and starts SyncLoop / MDLCheckLoop in background goroutines
payload.why_not_execute: There is no user-visible SQL wrapper carrying the current user's pending TxnReadTS into this path. Running the pending rowset oracle would require mutating a sys-session pool resource directly, which is outside the product-feasible state-ingress schedule.
payload.method_lesson: For SOURCE_TARGETS state-ingress, distinguish internal SQL presence from state-carrier ownership. Background sys-session-pool loops should become negative cache unless a separate user-visible metadata/state contract is found, as happened in grant/revoke.
payload.next_step: Continue with importer job/precheck dynamic candidates. Start from wrapper and session ownership proof before attempting a RED oracle.
